name: kotlin-jump
description: Fast Kotlin & Java navigation — Go to Definition, Find Usages, Go to Implementation. No language server needed.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Jetpack Compose @Composable function or state API (remember, mutableStateOf, etc.)
Kotlin sealed class or sealed interface
Kotlin extension function (has receiver type, e.g. fun String.foo())
Kotlin operator function (e.g. operator fun plus())

kotlinJump.maxIndexedFiles.description: Hard cap on the number of .kt files indexed.

kotlinJump.concurrency.description: Number of files read in parallel during initial scan.

kotlinJump.parserWorkers.description: Number of Node.js worker threads used for parallel Kotlin parsing.

kotlinJump.excludeFromReferences.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns excluded from **Find All References** results. Matched files are still indexed (Go to Definition still works inside them) but are hidden from reference results.

Example:
```json
[
  "**/src/test*/**",
  "**/src/savedAndroidTest*/**",
  "**/src/sharedTest*/**",
  "**/src/debug/**/*Preview.kt"
]
```

kotlinJump.testSourceSets.markdownDescription: Path segments identifying test source sets. Used by **Go to Definition** (to skip test-only results) and **Test Explorer** (to discover test functions by path). Add custom segments for non-standard layouts.

kotlinJump.gradleWrapper.markdownDescription: Path to the Gradle wrapper relative to the workspace root. Used when running tests from the **Test Explorer**.

kotlinJump.testTaskOverrides.markdownDescription:
Override the Gradle test task per module. Use this when a module has multiple product flavors and `testDebugUnitTest` is ambiguous.

Example:
```json
{
  ":replica:app": "testReplicaLaPresseDebugUnitTest"
}
```

kotlinJump.injectTestLogging.markdownDescription: Inject a Gradle init-script that enables `testLogging` (passed/failed/skipped events) on all test tasks. Gives live test names in the output panel even when the project doesn't configure `testLogging` itself. Disable if your project already configures it or if the init-script causes issues.

kotlinJump.testCodeLens.markdownDescription: Show **▶ Run** and **⏱ Debug** lenses above `@Test` methods and **▶ Run All** above test classes.

kotlinJump.smartNavigation.markdownDescription: When enabled, **Cmd+Click** on a declaration opens the custom Find Usages panel instead of VS Code's built-in References. Default: off (uses native VS Code References).

kotlinJump.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show **usages** and **implementations** counts inline above class and function declarations.

kotlinJump.semanticHighlighting.markdownDescription: Enable semantic token highlighting for Kotlin files (classes, functions, suspend, @Composable, etc.).

kotlinJump.maxReferences.markdownDescription: Maximum number of results returned by **Find Usages** and **Find All References**. Increase for completeness on large repos, decrease to keep scans fast.

kotlinJump.hoverEnabled.markdownDescription: Show hover tooltips with signature, KDoc, and type info. Disable if another extension (e.g. the JetBrains Kotlin LSP) already provides hover.

kotlinJump.fileSizeLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum file size in KB before a file is skipped during indexing. Increase to index large generated files; decrease to speed up scanning.

kotlinJump.snapshotEnabled.markdownDescription: Persist the symbol index to disk between sessions. Disable if the snapshot becomes stale or causes unexpected navigation results — the index will be rebuilt from scratch on every open.

kotlinJump.watcherDebounceMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after a file change before re-indexing it. Increase on slow machines or network drives to reduce churn; decrease for near-instant updates on fast SSDs.

kotlinJump.statusBarEnabled.markdownDescription: Show the Kotlin Jump status bar item (symbol count and indexing progress) in the bottom bar.

enumDescriptions: Detect the JetBrains Kotlin LSP automatically and enable companion mode when found.
Always run as a companion — disable hover, outline, rename, and semantic tokens regardless of other extensions.
Never enable companion mode — register all providers.
kotlinJump.companionMode.markdownDescription:
Controls how Kotlin Jump coexists with a full Kotlin language server such as the JetBrains Kotlin LSP.

When companion mode is active, Kotlin Jump disables overlapping providers (hover, document outline, rename, semantic tokens) and keeps only the fast navigation providers (Go to Definition, Find Usages, Go to Implementation, Type/Call Hierarchy, Code Lens).

- `auto` — detect the JetBrains Kotlin LSP and enable automatically
- `always` — always enable, useful with other LSPs that provide hover and outline
- `never` — disable, register all providers

kotlinJump.workspaceSymbolKinds.markdownDescription:
Restrict **Go to Symbol in Workspace** (Cmd+T) to specific symbol kinds. Empty array shows all kinds.

Example — classes and functions only:
```json
["class", "dataClass", "sealedClass", "fun", "composable"]
```

kotlinJump.organizeImports.removeUnused.markdownDescription:
Remove unused imports when running **Organize Imports** (`Shift+Alt+O`).

Uses a heuristic: if the imported simple name (or alias) does not appear as a word in the file, the import is removed. Wildcard imports are always kept.

**To run automatically on save**, add to your `settings.json`:
```json
"editor.codeActionsOnSave": { "source.organizeImports": "explicit" }
```

kotlinJump.indexSourcesJars.markdownDescription: Index Kotlin/Java sources from `-sources.jar` files in the Gradle cache. Enables KDoc and Go to Definition for library symbols (Compose, Coroutines, AndroidX…).

kotlinJump.sourcesJarsMaxCount.markdownDescription: Maximum number of `-sources.jar` files to index from the Gradle cache.

kotlinJump.gradleCacheDir.markdownDescription: Override the Gradle cache path. Leave empty to auto-detect `~/.gradle/caches/modules-2/files-2.1`.

kotlinJump.indexMavenSources.markdownDescription: Index Kotlin/Java sources from `-sources.jar` files in the Maven local repository (`~/.m2/repository`). Enables KDoc and Go to Definition for Maven-managed library symbols.

kotlinJump.mavenSourcesMaxCount.markdownDescription: Maximum number of `-sources.jar` files to index from the Maven local repository.

kotlinJump.mavenLocalRepoDir.markdownDescription: Override the Maven local repository path. Leave empty to auto-detect `~/.m2/repository`.

kotlinJump.useGradleTooling.markdownDescription: Use the Gradle Tooling API (`./gradlew`) to resolve the exact source JARs for the current project instead of scanning the full Gradle cache. Slower on first run but indexes only relevant dependencies. Requires `gradlew` in the workspace root.

kotlinJump.gradleToolingTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout in milliseconds for the Gradle Tooling API invocation (`kotlinJump.useGradleTooling`). Default: 30 000 ms.

kotlinJump.autoImport.enabled.markdownDescription: Show **Add import** quick-fix suggestions when the cursor is on an unresolved type name. Candidates are drawn from the symbol index — no JVM required.

kotlinJump.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter name hints inline at call sites (e.g. `modifier: m`). Clickable — navigates to the parameter declaration.

kotlinJump.inlayHints.inferredTypes.markdownDescription: Show inferred return type hints on untyped `val`/`var` declarations (e.g. `val users = fetchUsers()` → `: List<User>`). Double-click to insert the explicit type.

kotlinJump.signatureHelp.markdownDescription: Show function signature popup when typing `(` or `,` inside a call, with the active parameter highlighted. Disable if another extension already provides signature help.

kotlinJump.foldingEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable symbol-aware folding for Kotlin files (classes, functions, import block, KDoc). More accurate than VS Code's default indentation-based folding.

kotlinJump.stringResourceFolding.markdownDescription: Visually replace `R.string.foo` references with their actual string values (like Android Studio's Resource Value Folding). The real code reappears while your cursor is on the line.
